newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET- SRI LANKA WINS TOSS, PUT ZIMBABWE INTO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET- SRI LANKA WINS TOSS, PUT ZIMBABWE INTO BAT.

text.p: Sri Lanka won the toss and put
Zimbabwe into bat in the fifth limited overs cricket match in
the Singer World Series tournament in the Sri Lankan capital on
Zimbabwe - Alistair Campbell (captain), Andy Flower, Mark
Dekker, Craig Evans, Grant Flower, Paul Strang, Heath Streak,
Ali Shah, Andrew Whittall, Guy Whittall, Craig Wishart.
Sri Lanka - Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya,
Romesh Kaluwitharana, Asanka Gurusinha, Aravinda de Silva,
Hashan Tillekeratne, Muthiah Muralitharan, Upul Chandana, Marvan
